name.zh: eSIM Plus 爱沙尼亚号码

tagline.en: Global eSIM marketplace — its global plan bundles a permanent Estonian number with free SMS receiving
tagline.zh: 全球eSIM市场——全球套餐自带永久有效的爱沙尼亚号码，免费收短信

description.en: eSIM Plus (esimplus.me) is a global eSIM marketplace; its Global plan ships with an Estonian phone number, free SMS receiving and no expiry date — buy once, keep forever without top-ups. Pay by Visa/Mastercard or Google Pay; the QR code arrives in your order page. No real-name registration.
description.zh: eSIM Plus（esimplus.me）是全球eSIM交易平台；其全球套餐自带爱沙尼亚电话号码，免费收短信且无到期日——一次购买永久可用，无需充值保号。支持Visa/Mastercard与Google Pay支付，二维码在订单页获取。无需实名。

details.en:
eSIM Plus is an aggregator rather than a carrier: its Estonia-numbered global plan is the zero-maintenance option in this catalogue — the number is permanent, SMS receiving is free, and there is no keep-alive ritual at all (contrast giffgaff's 180-day rule or Moldtelecom's 6-month top-up).

Purchase flow per the 2025-09 source review: create an account with email, choose the global plan (which includes the Estonian number), pay by Visa/Mastercard/Google Pay, wait 2–3 minutes for confirmation, then fetch the number and eSIM QR code from the orders page.

Activation: native-eSIM phones scan the QR directly; others use an eSIM chip (e.g. Xesim) via the app's +/scan flow, about two minutes to load.

In mainland China the number roams with signal and SMS reception was verified working.

Caveats: this is a marketplace product — the underlying number's long-term fate depends on eSIM Plus's carrier arrangements, not a national carrier's retail arm; outbound calls/SMS and data are priced as add-ons; and 'permanent' means no expiry date is stated, not a regulator-guaranteed lifetime.
details.zh:
eSIM Plus是聚合平台而非运营商：其带爱沙尼亚号码的全球套餐是本目录中的「零维护」选项——号码永久有效、收短信免费、完全不需要保号仪式（对比giffgaff的180天规则或Moldtelecom的6个月充值）。

购买流程（2025-09源测评）：邮箱注册账号、选择全球套餐（自带爱沙尼亚号码）、Visa/Mastercard/Google Pay支付、等2-3分钟确认，随后在订单页查看号码与eSIM二维码。

激活：原生eSIM手机直接扫码；其他手机用eSIM芯片（如Xesim）经App的+/扫码流程写入，约两分钟加载完成。

在中国大陆漫游有信号，实测可正常收短信。

注意：这是平台产品——号码的长期存续取决于eSIM Plus与上游运营商的协议，而非国家级运营商的零售业务；通话/发短信与流量按叠加包计价；「永久」指官方不设到期日，并非监管担保的终身。

bestFor.en: Zero-maintenance SMS receiving: buy once, no top-up schedule, ever.
bestFor.zh: 零维护收短信：一次购买，永远不需要按日历充值。
